published: commercial product envelope 139 x 100 x 53 mm
commercial material family aluminium, alloy not disclosed
hypotheses: 3 mm solid rear plate without mounting holes
60 x 38 mm open elliptic crush shell
four axial core segments of equal length
cruciform core graded from 1.4 to 0.8 mm
no OEM bumper or body interface
geometry_authority.not_claimed: No Porsche or FVD surface, mounting pattern, load path, crash performance or fitment is claimed.

synthetic_cases.authority: regression inputs only; not a Porsche requirement, regulatory pulse, vehicle model or validated crash case

material_screen.scope: generic ambient screening values; no strain-rate, heat-treatment, orientation, defect or crash allowable

dfam_screen.part_consolidation: rear plate, elliptic shell and four graded cruciform core segments in one BREP

interpretation.crash: F*s is an energy target only; it does not predict the force-displacement curve, pulse, intrusion or occupant response
interpretation.strength: nominal yield and Euler results are upper bounds; thin-wall local folding, imperfections and joints govern crush
interpretation.buckling: flat-plate estimates do not represent the nonlinear progressive folding of the oval shell and graded core
interpretation.modal: equivalent cantilever shell mode excludes bumper beam, body attachment, ribs, joints and vehicle excitation
interpretation.mass: near agreement with 145 g is a scalar screen only and cannot validate geometry or crash behavior
interpretation.physicsnemo: deferred until a validated nonlinear explicit crash dataset with uncertainty and OOD gates exists
interpretation.simready: deferred until measured interfaces, material cards, contact definitions and a correlated solver case exist

release_blockers: No measured support, body rail, bumper beam, mounting datums, holes, fasteners, clearances or tolerances.
The 139 x 100 x 53 mm and 145 g values are commercial declarations, not a drawing or inspection report.

No strain-rate-dependent LPBF material card, anisotropy, fracture locus or defect population.
No nonlinear explicit shell/contact model, mesh convergence, imperfection study or force-displacement target.
No bumper-beam, longitudinal, body, fastener or adjacent-component model.
No build orientation, support strategy, recoater check, machining stock or distortion compensation.
No corrosion, galvanic, thermal-cycle, fatigue or road-debris assessment.
No dimensional inspection, CT, coupon, quasi-static crush, dynamic sled or full-vehicle crash test.
No professional crash engineering review or approved validation and homologation plan.
